test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Eight soldiers A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). D sits third to the right of A and second to the left of C. Only three soldiers sit between D and E. Only two solders sit between E and F. F sits second to the left of B. A is the neighbour of G. H sits to the right of D. How many soldiers are sitting between H and G?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: D sits third to the right of A and second to the left of C. Only three soldiers sit between D and E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c50021bb7971669552991aa8916dc0c6739f5f415cc038179565be421a398e98.png] 

We place D and then A & C according to the conditions, now we place E with three spots from the left of D.

Step 2: Only two soldiers sit between E and F. F sits second to the left of B.</
